prompt: Briefly  explain what the popular open source tool crowdsec is
response: CrowdSec is an open-source tool that provides real-time threat intelligence and protection against various online threats. It detects and blocks malicious IP addresses by analyzing logs and sharing threat data with a community-driven database. CrowdSec can be easily integrated into existing security systems to enhance protection against attacks like brute force, DDoS, and scanning activities. It offers a centralized management interface for monitoring and managing security rules.
